people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
translations.bsb: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
translations.kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served
translations.asv: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
